jobs.title: VAPT Intern
jobs.description: Join our security team for hands-on experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing. Work on real-world security challenges.
jobs.fullDescription: As a VAPT Intern, you'll work alongside our security experts to identify vulnerabilities in web applications, networks, and infrastructure. This is a 3-6 month intensive program where you'll learn industry-standard tools and methodologies while contributing to actual client projects. You'll gain practical experience in ethical hacking, security assessment, and vulnerability remediation.
requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field
Basic understanding of web application security (OWASP Top 10)
Familiarity with security tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, or Metasploit
Knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Passion for cybersecurity and ethical hacking
responsibilities: Conduct vulnerability assessments on web applications and networks
Perform penetration testing under supervision of senior security engineers
Document findings and create detailed security reports
Assist in security research and tool development
Participate in security training and knowledge sharing sessions
Help maintain security testing infrastructure
benefits: Hands-on experience with enterprise security tools
Mentorship from experienced security professionals
Opportunity to work on real client projects
Flexible remote work schedule
Certificate of completion and recommendation letter
Potential for full-time conversion based on performance

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer (Equity + Revenue Share Only)
jobs.description: Creative, chronically-online, internet-culture-aware CMO to help shape the public identity of an early-stage cybersecurity startup focused on SMB protection. This is a revenue sharing and equity-only role for now.
jobs.fullDescription:
PurpleRain Tech is looking for a creative, chronically-online, internet-culture-aware CMO to help shape the public identity of an early-stage cybersecurity startup focused on SMB protection.

This is not a traditional corporate role. We want someone who understands branding, aesthetics, social media psychology, trends, short-form content, and how to make a cybersecurity company actually feel human online.

About PurpleRain Tech:
PurpleRain builds cybersecurity infrastructure and monitoring solutions for small and medium businesses using affordable hardware, real-time alerts, and centralized dashboards. We focus on making enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to smaller companies without enterprise-level pricing.
requirements: Strong taste in design, fashion, music, internet culture, or aesthetics
Comfortable on camera or directing content
Understands startup culture and fast execution
Can balance "professional" with culturally relevant
Bonus if you've worked on personal brands, edits, meme pages, fan pages, startup socials, or creator projects
responsibilities: Brand identity and positioning
Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, LinkedIn strategy
Viral marketing campaigns and memes
Creator partnerships and community building
Launch strategy, PR, and investor-facing presence
Content direction for reels, edits, and skits
Building PurpleRain into a recognizable internet-native tech brand
benefits: Equity + revenue sharing only for now
Potential transition into salaried role after funding/revenue milestones
Significant creative freedom and direct influence over company direction
